Class ControllerLessonEditor

java.lang.Object
guiLessonEditor.ControllerLessonEditor
public class ControllerLessonEditor extends Object

Title: ControllerLessonEditor Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based lesson editor controller. It reacts to the Save and Cancel buttons. Save reads the five fields, hands them to ModelLessonEditor, and either reports the first problem through the shared ValidationAlert or moves on to the saved lesson.

As in the supplied controllers, this is a collection of protected static methods called by the View, and is never instantiated.

  • Method Details

    • performSave

      protected static void performSave()

      Method: performSave()

      Description: Saves the form as a new lesson (CS-1) or as changes to the lesson being edited (CS-7). If anything is refused (CS-9, CS-10, CS-11) the reason is shown and the form is left exactly as the contributor typed it, so they can correct the one field that was wrong rather than starting again. On success the contributor is taken to the detail page of the saved lesson, which shows the identifier the lesson was given (CS-1).

    • performCancel

      protected static void performCancel()

      Method: performCancel()

      Description: Leaves the editor without saving. When editing, the contributor goes back to the lesson they were editing; when recording a new lesson, back to the list. Nothing in the form is kept, because nothing was confirmed.
